services.name: Tubing On The American River
services.desc: Tubing the American River is a guest favorite for cooling off from May through September. This family-friendly float starts just below Troublemaker Rapid and drifts gently to Henningsen Park. Stop by our General Store for tubes and required life jackets to start your summer

gap: Prices for accommodations and activities not stated
blurb: Guests can stay in cozy cabins, full hookup RV sites, or riverside tent spots. The resort provides miles of riverfront access for gold panning, fishing, floating, or rafting adventures. On-site amenities include a State Park museum, hiking and biking trails, playgrounds, a swimming pool, and a full summer activity schedule.
